fixes.explanation: That's him, friend. The LORD tells Moses to cross the Arnon Valley and says, “See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land.” Sihon is the first king Moses names in this retelling. Og, king of Bashan, comes later in the passage.

Gentle isn't the word, friend. Moses says the LORD “…had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate…” Israel asked to pass through on the main road and offered silver for food and water, but Sihon would not let them pass. The verse describes his spirit as stubborn, not gentle.
